scope: Compact, lossless selection of reported validation metadata and per-run summaries. Raw timing arrays remain in the archived original JSON files.

extraction.timestampMeaning: Manifest extraction time only; never an inferred test execution time.
extraction.sourceOfMetadata: Existing JSON report fields only. Current harness/product bytes are not substituted for missing execution-time hashes.

rawArchive.entryNaming: Each rawPath is also its expected ZIP entry path, relative to repository root.

interpretation: A reported candidateHead identifies the checked-out commit, not necessarily all measured working-tree bytes. Use reported source hashes/tree references.
The model evidence was recorded before HP fusion was removed. Its unchanged subsystem sources must be checked against the final source manifest; this file does not invent that match.

preFlushSafetyBrowserRender describes a superseded candidate and is excluded from final performance claims. The final renderer retains actor sorting and ghost actor flush boundaries, and effect culling was reverted.
Only finalBrowserRender provides final renderer timing evidence. Earlier hidden simulation observations predate the render-order safety fix and do not substitute for final framebuffer regressions.

validationSupport references final correctness reports. historicalFlushDiagnostics contains earlier incident diagnostics; its complete status means the records exist, not that those candidates passed.

UI operation samples use synthetic 60 Hz clock inputs; they are not measured browser frame cadence. Settled UI measuredStartTick may be 140 after warmup, while the fixture initially settles for 120 ticks.
Use presentationAndUiCpu for UI cost adoption. cpu alone measures sync and can hide work moved into presentation.
Native and UI handCounts counters are distinct. Retained-heap differences are not allocation or GC measurements.
Dense model windows contain 40 samples per run; their nearest-rank p99 is the maximum and is not a robust general tail-latency estimate.
Node contact summary.json is not imported as pooled percentile evidence. This manifest keeps each raw report round and its own summaries.
Node contact timing includes notice-observer work inside step; low-level counting instrumentation is a separate untimed pass.
No physical mobile FPS, browser compositor time, GPU completion time or GC pause reduction is established by these reports.
Missing source/harness/time metadata remains explicitly missing. No pass status overrides an incomplete provenance record.

adoptedBrowserModel.role: Performance evidence for unchanged contact model; compare only within each paired case.
